newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Hoogovens faces possible strike.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Hoogovens faces possible strike.

text.p: Talks between management and the trade union at Dutch steel and aluminium group Hoogovens have broken down, raising the prospect of strike action, union sources said on Monday.
The FNV trade union said the action, on which members were being ballotted this week, would only affect the steel division of the company, leaving aluminium output unscathed.
"We are meeting with the workers to find out their views on possible action but we will put an ultimatum back to management first," a trade union source said.
He added that strike action was not iminent and there would be further negotiations with the company's management.
The dispute between the union and management was sparked by the division's plans to discharge 3,000 of its employees and recruit 1,000 new, highly-trained workers as a replacement.
A spokewoman for Hoogovens confirmed that there were workers' meetings this week but declined to comment on the potential effect of any strike action on steel production.
ANP agency said on Saturday that the management had refused to guarantee demands that there should be no compulsory redundancies as part of the move.
